analysis: Examined the supplied portions of the PR. ProviderLoop+Serve.swift (patch lines ~295-400) adds a work-FIFO admission mechanism. Each non-order-free event now awaits awaitReleasedAdmissions() first. Inference requests are wrapped in admitInWorkFIFO with a gate passed to handleInferenceRequest. Cancels are deferred via deferCancelForReleasedAdmission. The work consumer awaits all released admissions before ending. The connection-control reader (eventTask) is unchanged and still handles appAttestShadow and trustStatus synchronously ahead of the work queue. So attestation/authorization renewal and invalidation (T-053, T-057, TB-011) are not delayed by the new waiting. Residual question: events.overtakesReleasedAdmissions, admitInWorkFIFO, WorkFIFOGate and deferCancelForReleasedAdmission live in ProviderLoop+WorkFIFO.swift, which was not supplied. I could not verify that .disconnected, attestationChallenge and .cancel ordering, or cancellation of admissions parked on a model load, behave correctly (T-010 cancel propagation; stale-request-after-disconnect handling in T-053). I also could not verify that the gate is always released on every early return in handleInferenceRequest. In ProviderLoop+InferenceHandler.swift, the patch swaps decodeOpenAIRequest and extractChatTemplateControls for a single decodeInboundChatRequest, whose implementation was not supplied. I could not verify that the parse is equivalent and that inbound.extensions carry the same authenticated plaintext semantics. The head_text lines 1146-1515 (streaming loop, billing floors, logprobs, cache-hit reporting, response attestation, terminal send) show no visible security regression. Plaintext frames are emitted via emitSSE, which is the encrypting path in unchanged code. Cache metadata reporting is gated by remoteCache.scope. No new cache scope handling or disk artifacts were observed (T-041 unchanged). Recommend a follow-up on ProviderLoop+WorkFIFO.swift and InboundDecode.
